The balls appear to be AI-generated, exhibiting significant structural deformations, particularly in the middle and right-center spheres which show 'melting' or fusion artifacts where the spherical shape collapses into irregular blobs. The stitching patterns are inconsistent, with some appearing correct while others merge into the white leather or distort unnaturally. One ball features green markings instead of the traditional red stitching.
